_comment: Generated by scripts/build_patch_data.py from the cached EA page in data/patch-source/. 'text' is EA's exact wording and must stay that way - scripts/build_patch_data.py --check re-reads EA's page and fails if any bullet is missing or altered. 'section' and 'items' are meant to be hand-corrected and are not overwritten by --check.

entries.text: Corrected an issue where desynchronised stance transitions between first-person and third-person cameras could contribute to some instances of players appearing to die behind cover.
heading: PLAYER:

entries.text: Corrected an issue where the game could become unresponsive when resuming from a suspended state during active gameplay.
heading: PLAYER:

entries.text: Corrected an issue where using the third weapon slot as Assault could grant XP toward your Primary Weapon instead of the weapon in hand.
heading: PROGRESSION:

entries.text: Corrected an issue where the “Game Started” UI could be missing when joining Operation Augur after the match had already begun.
